risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 51 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple bearish confirmations (EMA death cross, price below both key EMAs, three black crows, weak ADX trend strength, no momentum confirmation) combined with severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) and high earnings risk in 51 days make this a low-probability setup with asymmetric downside.
